__HIDDENCAT__
This hidden maintenance category collects pages with an Erenshor link to a page shared by several abilities or by things with different icons. Things that share a page and an icon need no key, except abilities whose tooltips need an exact identity.

To fix a page, give each such link a <code>stablekey</code>. In the source editor, the '''Erenshor link''' button in the ''Insert'' group finds the correct key. See [[Erenshor Wiki:Game Data#Maintenance categories]].
